scope: Win32 C/C++ source strings passed to native UI sinks

rules.translate: Ordinary fixed UI copy is backed by IDS_LOC_* resources and loaded through the Win32 localization layer.
rules.preserve: Product, tool, file-format, hardware, emulator, TAS, and API tokens keep their original spelling and case.
rules.exclude: Runtime data, resource identifiers, configuration keys, addresses, register values, paths, file names, logs, disassembly text, and string-concatenation fragments are not translated directly.

dynamicStringCoverage.reason: Fixed English UI strings are mapped to paired en-US and zh-CN IDS_LOC resources. Runtime arguments remain outside the resource text.

fileDialogDecision.reason: OPENFILENAME titles, filters, and path buffers remain unchanged in this change to avoid altering file dialog encoding and file I/O behavior.

knownSourceExceptions.reason: The compiled UI string is concatenated with 7z.dll and is covered by IDS_LOC_7Z_DLL_NOT_FOUND.
The compiled UI string is concatenated with 7z.dll and is covered by IDS_LOC_7Z_DLL_NOT_FOUND.
The compiled UI string is concatenated with 7z.dll and is covered by IDS_LOC_7Z_DLL_INVALID.

moduleDecisions.reason: Message boxes and file dialog titles use ordinary UI actions while preserving FCEUX, ROM, FCM, FM2, and 7z.dll tokens.
Fixed prompts and button state labels are localized; key names, device names, paths, and numeric values remain runtime data.
Fixed prompts are localized while addresses, registers, disassembly, log text, PRG/CHR/RAM/ROM tokens, and tool names are preserved.
Movie and TAS Editor prompts are localized, while TAS Editor, FM2/FM3, Lua, SaveRam, Savestate, Power-On, and Soft-Reset are preserved.
